column1: # Tatara Android builder toolchain (AWAI-3834). One line per component: name, version, source, digest.
# kind: tar|txz|zip = archive we download and check by sha256; sdk = installed by the pinned sdkmanager, which
# checks Google's sha1 from repository2-3.xml (the only digest Google publishes). After install, install.sh
# records a sha256 tree digest of every component in the toolchain's manifest.lock, and checks it on every boot.
# The toolchain id is the sha256 of this file: change a line and a new toolchain directory is built.
# cmdline-tools stays at 20.0, the classic Java sdkmanager (sha256 pinned here): 23.0's sdkmanager downloads an
# unpinned 79 MB android-cli into ~/.android/bin and runs it (seen 2026-11-22, AWAI-3834).
# build-tools 36.0.0 is AGP 9's default; Gradle cannot install it (the SDK is read-only to steps, by design).
